paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu listened silently to the conversation outside as the fragrance of Lady Sena's hair entered his nostrils. Lady Sena, even to the ears painted red, seemed not to have heard a word of the conversation beyond the window. She merely clung tightly to her own happiness, fearful that someone else might snatch it away. She had no inkling that this world would never permit her alone to possess happiness all to herself.

paragraphs.source_en: After Nabenosuke's coming-of-age ceremony came the drinking of the ceremonial wine for the campaign; by the time everything was over, the Hour of the Tiger had arrived. Takechiyo, too, was brought by his wet nurse to attend the victory-chestnut feast, and a dab of sacred sake from the cup was placed upon his forehead. By then, the men and horses had arrived from Sekiguchi Gyōbu's residence and assembled before Motoyasu's quarters; around the Shōshō Palace, men's shouts mingled with neighing horses in a tumult of noise.
